naturalized to represent Vietnam, debuted at 2024 AFC Asian Cup

off_pitch.family_situation: Born in the Czech Republic to a Czech mother and Vietnamese father.

data_quality.notes: Born 14 Sep 1992 in Czech Republic to a Czech mother and Vietnamese father; career started at Sparta Prague, later Slovan Liberec and Slovacko (Czech Goalkeeper of the Year 2018/19); joined Cong An Ha Noi (then Hanoi Police Club) June 2023 as a free transfer on a 3-year deal (-> contract_until approx 2026, may since have been renewed, not confirmed); helped CAHN win the 2023 V-League; obtained Vietnamese nationality and debuted for the Vietnam national team at the 2024 AFC Asian Cup.
